body.x: ROMY PARIS introduced ‘Beauty coaching system’ that can be used in a smart way at 'CES 2018 Unveiled' in 7th of January in Las Vegas, United States.

The product shown by ROMY PARIS is ‘Figure’, a capsule make-up maker. It provides a solution for an individual skin condition. First, information about the external environment can be obtained through smartphones and applications, and then cosmetics can be made to fit your skin based on the big data that is provided. Users can choose and use capsules with the functions such as protection against ageing and block ultraviolet rays.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
